original_test_intent: Validate HGX PCIe L1 power-management interoperability by proving each approved NVQual Test #30 entry reaches the intended L1 state/substate and each wake returns the full NVIDIA path and function within latency limits without hang, unplanned reboot or error.
original_method: Pin ASPM ownership, L1/L1.1/L1.2 target, path capabilities, idle entry condition, minimum residency, wake stimulus, exit latency, iterations, link/device/function/error acceptance and restored policy; preserve baselines; record every complete entry-residency-wake transaction before the next; stop on first fault and recover out of band.
manual_activity: HGX owner/FAE approves ASPM ownership, substate, latency and iterations; an operator isolates the SUT, observes out-of-band health and owns policy restoration/recovery.
required_inputs: Pinned NVQual Test #30 L1 configuration and compatible firmware/driver
Complete path and L1/L1SS capability map
ASPM owner, L1/substate, idle entry, residency, wake source, exit latency and link/function rules
Iterations/timing, error acceptance, policy restoration, storage, aborts and recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production HGX SUT and explicit L1 policy authorization
No unsaved workload; verified console/BMC recovery; do not force unsupported state
Stop on missed entry, insufficient residency, wake timeout, link/device loss or downtraining, driver/GPU failure, hang/reboot, new AER, thermal/power fault, tool failure or evidence gap
No evidence clearing, reset/power escalation or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate Test #30 recipe, capabilities, policy owner, baseline, interlocks and recovery
Run only approved L1 entry/exit cycles
Commit entry/residency/wake/latency/link/device/function/error evidence before the next cycle
Do not infer substate, force policy, retry faults or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Test #30 recipe, path/substate/policy, iterations and latency
Define entry/residency/wake/link/function/error acceptance and final policy
Review the full ledger and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It identifies L1 but generic link/device snapshots cannot prove state entry, residency or wake latency and it supplies no substate or policy contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the pinned Test #30 configuration with an atomic ledger and block cycle N+1 until N proves intended entry/residency, approved wake, measured exit latency, restored link/device/function state and acceptable errors.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #30, L1 power management, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/180-minute allocation remain; missing states and counts are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL INTERLOCKED HGX L1 POWER MANAGEMENT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each L1 cycle as an observable entry-residency-wake transaction bound to capability, policy, latency, full device/function health and error state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds substate/policy identity, residency proof, wake latency, transaction evidence, first-fault inhibition, restoration and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final L0 link cannot prove any L1 entry occurred, residency was sufficient or earlier wake latency and transient errors were acceptable.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Conflicting firmware/OS/vendor policy or unsupported substates can prevent entry, strand endpoints or destabilize the host.

project_override_considerations: Counter/trace proof of residency is allowed only with approved mapping and gap-free timestamps. A retrain, D3 cycle, reboot or power cycle is not L1 coverage. Setup and failed/incomplete transitions do not count.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #30 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus path L1/L1SS capabilities and initial policy
Complete L1/L1SS traces or counters, lspci/NVIDIA/AER/dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL/console/thermal/power evidence
First-fault recovery or clean restored policy/device/host state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test #30 Procedure, Criteria and same-row AI review consistently target L1 power management. Missing substate and policy semantics are readiness under-specification, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The L1 objective is clear. Proprietary tooling, capabilities, policy, latency, evidence and recovery are identifiable prerequisites rather than permanent review blockers.

review_improvement: Requires proof of L1 entry/residency and wake latency instead of accepting a final active link, while preserving all Test #30 stability coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: L1 is a power-management state, not a speed retrain. Valid coverage depends on policy ownership, an idle condition that permits entry, observable residency and deterministic wake/exit latency. The final active state erases those intermediate facts, so each cycle must be committed before another transition and halted on the first missed entry or failed wake.
